qs.q: A researcher is studying physiologic negative feedback mechanisms in the coagulation cascade. Which of the following describes the primary action of tissue factor pathway inhibitor?
o: Stimulation of tissue plasminogen activator release
Cleavage and inactivation of factors Va and VIIIa
Inhibition of the factor VIIa-tissue factor complex
qs.e: TFPI directly inhibits the factor VIIa-tissue factor complex to limit extrinsic pathway activity. Inactivation of factors Va and VIIIa is instead performed by activated protein C.
